chunks: Peace be on Moses and Aaron.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the peace of Moses and Aaron?
ai.summary: In Surah As-Saffat, this verse highlights the divine recognition of the prophetic brotherhood of Musa and Harun, emphasizing their shared mission and enduring peace (Salam) as a reward for their steadfastness. Shia scholarship often views this as a precursor to the concept of 'Salam' bestowed upon the Ahl al-Bayt, linking the tranquility of these prophets to the spiritual purity and intercessory status of the Imams in the hereafter.
